boundaries.production: Verified raw reads, rolling 3-frame mean, display, overlays, bounded FFmpeg, packet/full-decode checks, durable MP4 publication and SHA; excludes host capture, job databases and central object publication. Five source minutes, one trial per case. Warm OS caches, no global cache flush.
boundaries.contention: Same-process native EncodedPreview recipe with 5 warmups then 30 arrivals at 5-second cadence. Continuous serial 5-minute videos are repeated load only, not a longer sky sequence. Excludes complete acquisition/ingress/outbox.
boundaries.dayOptimization: Integer-black fixed-transfer fast path; bit-exact JPEG and MP4 before/after on both hosts.
boundaries.gpu: Existing RTX5070 and driver. Actual native NVENC canary. 32GiB virtual address / 2GiB child RSS; no installed-state changes.

rejectedRuns: First production attempt: preencode empty-payload JSON record comparison; fixed before valid v2 measurements.
NVIDIA v2: CUDA initialization failed at 8GiB virtual address; fixed to bounded 32GiB.
Local contention v5: process-exit race during RSS read; failed output excluded; corrected v6 candidate measured against unchanged v5 baseline.
